# Synthetic and private fixtures

Committed fixtures are generated by `SyntheticFixture.hpp`; they contain no
redistributable O2Jam music or samples.  Each characterization manifest records
the source SHA-256, parsed metadata, event tuples, package kind/sample IDs,
duration, tags, and decoded-audio measurements.

To opt in to private characterization, place assets and a manifest beneath
`tests/fixtures/private/`.  That directory is ignored except for its README.
Never commit private OJN/OJM assets, legacy runtime DLLs, or their audio output.
